movielens_v2.task_description: turn a natural-language movie request into a semantic catalog search and grounded recommendations
movielens_v2.catalog_description: MovieLens movies enriched with TMDb title, overview, genres, keywords, user tags, cast, characters, directors, writers, composers, collection and production companies

metadata_hints.languages: original-language codes such as en or it
metadata_hints.countries: country codes present in origin/production metadata

planner_instructions: Names of actors/directors and thematic descriptions remain in semantic_query rather than becoming unsupported structured filters.
Do not infer year, runtime, language, country or genre constraints unless the user states them.
answer_instructions: Explain why each suggested movie matches the request using retrieved metadata/text.
Do not claim that a movie has attributes absent from its retrieved payload.

whoteach_template.user_role: teacher designing or authoring a learning experience
whoteach_template.task_description: transform a teacher's request into semantic retrieval over teacher-controlled educational resources and explain which grounded resources can support the authoring task
whoteach_template.catalog_description: teacher-curated instructional resources converted to semantic fragments and enriched with contextual metadata such as topic, source document and instructional context
planner_instructions: This is a template profile: populate allowed_filter_keys only after the real WhoTeach chunk/payload schema is frozen.
Keep pedagogical intent, topic, desired activity and learning objective in semantic_query unless a corresponding structured metadata field is actually available.
answer_instructions: Treat retrieved teacher-curated resources as the grounding source.
Separate evidence from the retrieved resource from pedagogical suggestions generated by the assistant.

movielens_coldstart_v2.task_description: turn a natural-language movie request into a semantic catalog search and grounded recommendations
movielens_coldstart_v2.catalog_description: Movies described by public TMDb title, genres, overview, keywords, cast and crew; no user tags or interaction aggregates.
planner_instructions: The request contains only explicitly revealed movie titles and numerical ratings on a 0.5–5 scale.
Describe positive preferences (ratings >=4) and unwanted themes (ratings <=2); treat ratings 2.5–3.5 as neutral.
Always return filters={} in this benchmark. Do not infer metadata constraints from movie preferences.
Do not recommend titles in semantic_query; represent preferences using themes, style and descriptive concepts.
answer_instructions: Explain why each suggested movie matches the request using retrieved metadata/text.
Do not claim that a movie has attributes absent from its retrieved payload.
